correctness.rationale: Gaussian KL reduces exactly to an orthogonally invariant spectral expression. The coordinate-stationarity identity and Cauchy--Schwarz show every potential interior maximum is a strict one-coordinate minimum, forcing the full compact-cube maximizers to vertices. Vertex substitution gives the claimed finite formula and all equality cases; strict sign and concavity properties identify the continuous peak, and Taylor expansion gives both asymptotics. An extracted standard-library verifier passed 8770 finite checks; these supplement the proof.

value.rationale: The paper’s isotropic complement covariance requires quantifying calibration of Gaussian uncertainty. The new formula is the exact worst-case directed-KL certificate at any dimension and cap, identifies all adverse spectra, and improves a general quadratic-in-condition-number scale to the provably optimal linear scale for large condition number. Such a bound is relevant for testing conservative uncertainty-quantification guarantees; it is not a mere parameter substitution or a generic invocation of Kantorovich.
